name: Bright Noa
source:
From: Mobile Suit Gundam Char's Counterattack
The commander of the Londo Bell, a unit independent of the Earth Federatior Space Force. Rank: Captain. Age: 36. Ever since his time in command of the White Base during the One Year War, he has served as captain of multiple vessels carrying Gundam-type Mobile Suits. He was famous as a commander of Newtype teams.
